title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of WMoNbCrTi HEAs Sintered from the Powders Milled for Different Durations
process_description: prepared by high-energy planetary ball milling under an Ar atmosphere with a milling speed of 300 rpm and a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 10:1, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1400°C for 8 min under a pressure of 30 MPa in a near vacuum of 10^3 Pa
